title: Design Challenge

blocks.title: Mission
blocks.text: Create ONE paper cupcake design that represents teamwork, communication and creativity.

items: Blank paper for each student; pencils, markers and coloured pencils for each team of 3–4

items.title: Sketch alone
items.text: Each student sketches one idea, without talking.

items.title: Share ideas
items.text: Each student shows one idea; teammates name one idea to keep.

items.title: Agree and design
items.text: The team draws ONE cupcake on its worksheet, showing at least three teamwork qualities.
Keep it short and silent. A student may tell you the idea instead of drawing it.
Ask who hasn’t added an idea yet; each person names one thing that must stay.
Ask what they can keep from both ideas: one cupcake, not a collage.
The student describes the idea or points while a teammate draws.

items: Every student’s idea shows up somewhere in the team cupcake.
At least three teamwork qualities, such as communication, inclusion, creativity, trust or collaboration.
The team can explain the meaning behind its design.
